records.title: Records
records.subtitle: Turn case files of any kind into searchable records
records.intro: Upload or photograph anything a case generates — paper documents, spreadsheets, reports, presentations, and audio or video recordings. Scans are read by OCR, recordings are transcribed, and everything becomes searchable. The assistant can answer questions from these records too.
records.dropHint: Drop files, paste them, or click to browse · Scans, PDFs, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, text, audio and video
records.searchPlaceholder: Search titles, document text, crime numbers…
records.empty: Nothing digitised yet — photograph or upload a document above to get started.
records.ocrNote: Read by OCR — verify against the original before relying on it. Corrections you save here are what the assistant will search.
records.noText: No text was extracted from this scan.
records.deleteBody: The scan and its extracted text are permanently removed.

reportStudio.title: Report Studio
reportStudio.subtitle: Draft, edit & file statutory police reports
reportStudio.intro: Pick a report type to start from its prescribed template — CCTNS IIF forms, BNSS registers and departmental review formats. Drafts autosave to the archive.
reportStudio.searchPlaceholder: Search by title, reference, type or officer…
reportStudio.empty: No saved reports yet — pick a template above to draft the first one.
reportStudio.linkCase: Link this report to a case
reportStudio.deleteBody: It disappears from this list. The filed copy is retained in the archive, so it can still be recovered.

diary.title: Investigation Diary

crimeLinks.eachCircle: Each circle is a ring, sized by members
crimeLinks.linkedRings: Linked rings share a district or crime type
